description: This file defines the class MockLegacyKeypad, which extends MockLegacySecurityDevice and implements MockPeripheral and MockSecurityController. It models a mock legacy keypad device including initialization of device properties and interaction with a MockLegacyKeypadCluster.

classes.name: MockLegacyKeypad
classes.description: A mock class simulating a legacy keypad device, including device configuration and cluster interaction.

methods.name: MockLegacyKeypad
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MockLegacyKeypad with name and optional EUI-64 identifier, setting device properties and creating a keypad cluster.

methods.name: requestPanelStateChange
methods.description: Requests a change in the panel state by invoking the corresponding method on the keypad cluster.
